decisions: The 34 index-derived paths without witnesses are mostly Advent feria inheritance hypotheses or special octave cases. They cannot be deemed absent Mass Propers.
Quad5-5 already has an existing deliberate hold: Seven Sorrows of the BVM Mass is not a universal 1962 Passion Friday default.
Quad6-5 Good Friday is a separate native rite, not an Ordinary Mass Proper; Quad6-6 Easter Vigil has native four-prophecy source-order requirements.
Seven O antiphon articles are Divine Office/devotional evidence, not separate daily Mass formularies.
The 60 rows with no reliable direct path include historical octave and pre-1955 source variants and cannot be counted as missing.
Date-specific rubrical claims and icon/posture ownership belong to the other Ordo Missae audit, not this pipeline.
